units: <cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 10:4">Men. X, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Menachot 66a:17">66ᵃ</cite>) <he>כדי לקיים בו מצות ק׳</he> in order to comply with the law requiring it to be parched (<cite ref="Leviticus 2:14">Lev. II, 14</cite>); Sifra Vayikra, N’dab., ch. XIV, Par. 13 <he>קָלוּי</he> (v. <cite ref="S01258"><he>קָלָה</he> II</cite>).
<cite ref="Menachot 66b:1">Men. 66ᵇ</cite> <he>אין לשון ק׳ אלא דבר אחר</he> Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note, a.

Yalk. Lev. 456) by ḳoli (parched) we understand the intercession of something else between the fire and the object to be affected by it; קליל וכ׳ (דבר) ל״א אין לשון ק׳ אלא another version reads: by ḳoli we understand, parched in a vessel (in something hollow); how is this? A tube for parching grain was there &c. Sifra Emor ch. XI, Par. 10 קמח ק׳ flour made of parched grain; Men. X, 5 קמח וק׳ (Bab. ed. 67ᵇ קמח ק׳); Pes. 10ᵇ bot. קמח וק׳ (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Pesachim 11a:8">Ib. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>מק׳ ואילך</he> from the time the grain is parched and onward (when the soft grain is unfit for immediate consumption); <he>עד ק׳</he> up to the time when grain can be parched; <cite ref="Menachot 68a:9">Men. 68ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 155b:16">Sabb. 155ᵇ</cite> <he>אין גובלין את הק׳</he> you must not mix flour of parched grains (with oil &c., on the Sabbath).

<cite ref="Tosefta Pesachim 2:4">Tosef. Pes. II</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Pesachim 3:4">III</cite>), 4 <he>ק׳ שירד לתוכו דלף</he> (not <he>לתוכה</he>) parched grain on which drippings have fallen; a. fr.—Pl. <he>קְלָיוֹת</he>, <cite ref="S01241"><he>קְלָאִים</he></cite>, <cite ref="S01241"><he>קְלָאִין</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Menachot 66b:1">Men. 66ᵇ</cite> <he>אבוב של ק׳</he> (not <he>אביב</he>); <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 2:3">Kel. II, 3</cite>; Sifra Vayikra, l. c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 456:2">Yalk. Lev. 456</cite>, v. <cite ref="A00056"><he>אַבּוּב</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 2:1">Keth. II, 1</cite> <he>חלוק ק׳</he>, v. <cite ref="H00772"><he>חִילּוּק</he></cite>. Y. ib. 28ᵇ top <he>בתולה … אין לה חילוק ק׳</he> at the wedding of a virgin that had been married before, no distribution of roasted ears takes place; a. fr.
